name: FurHouse
summary: In this Big Brother-inspired furry visual novel, your vote determined who stayed, who went, and who won. 12 young adults entered the FurHouse with the hopes of winning the 100,000 dollar grand prize. With no access to their phones or the outside world, they braved social challenges, constant camera surveillance, and each other in order to make it through. Every two weeks, from March 15 to July 18, an episode of FurHouse was released. Contestants were put up for elimination and the collective vote of all of the readers determined who went home.
